transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been struggling because my mood has been abnormally elevated and irritable for a long time. I also have this overwhelming increase in energy that I just can't seem to manage, and it's been going on for over a year now.
During these periods of high energy, have you ever had to be hospitalized, or did your behavior become so extreme that it caused serious problems with your work, safety, or relationships?

Yes, it has become quite extreme. My constant need to start new work projects and reach out to everyone I know has caused major friction at my job and strained my closest relationships, and I've also found myself acting in risky, hypersexual ways that feel completely out of my control.

latest_inference.note: Previously, the candidates were [Bipolar I Disorder, Bipolar II Disorder]. Given the patient's report of extreme impairment in occupational and social functioning, as well as high-risk behavior, the clinical presentation meets the criteria for a manic episode rather than a hypomanic episode, narrowing the diagnosis to Bipolar I Disorder.
